# Station CSV example
NOAA-IFS-stations.csv is the verifiedUTF-8/CRLF cmd/export output:8 station/field
rows,4 finite samples and4 geographic gaps. Fixed header11 fields; value empty
means missing, while actual0 stays0. Product/contributors are JSON inside CSV
cells. Data sources and transformations are attributed in LICENSES.md.
REFERENCE.json pins inputs and the previously captured independent SciPy values.
This file demonstrates supported repacked5.0 inputs, not original compression.
